Job description: 
As a Logistic Worker, you will become part of the heartbeat of Schiphol's freight operations. Every shift, you help shipments move safely and efficiently across the globe. You'll work in a fast‑paced environment, stay physically active, and learn valuable logistic skills. Early hours, strong teamwork, and clear routines make this job ideal for people who enjoy hands‑on work and visible results. 
As a Logistic Worker, you will be responsible for the following activities: - Scanning & labeling shipments; - Sorting packages for delivery; - Keeping the warehouse organized. 
Worktimes/days and hours per week: 
You start early and finish early, perfect if you enjoy having your afternoons free.

Job requirements: - Own transportation (public transport is not an option); - Parttime availability for at a minimum of 3 days per week. - Able to obtain a VOG and able to do a certification before starting; - Physically fit and comfortable with active work; - You speak Dutch and/or English.
